diagnosed_defects.name: Missing Geometry Seed Resolution at Assembly
diagnosed_defects.root_cause: Replay script looked in non-existent reproduction/ subfolder, defaulting arm lengths to 12.0/14.0 in instead of 14.5/12.0 in. Closed arm-club kinematic loop could not close.
diagnosed_defects.initial_impact: 46.177 mm marker discrepancy at t=0 before any motion.
diagnosed_defects.repaired_metric: 1.554e-12 mm (1.554 femtometers) marker agreement at t=0, KinematicsSolver status=1 (27/27 targets satisfied).

diagnosed_defects.name: Translational Force Double-Rotation
diagnosed_defects.root_cause: Candidate world-frame forces were pre-multiplied by rot_wb in replay script, while Simulink model already contained ConvertGlobalXtoHipBaseLocal block performing the rotation internally.
diagnosed_defects.initial_impact: Swapped Fy and Fz forces, injected ~383 N false lateral force, caused initial hip angular acceleration of 160 rad/s^2 vs -1.1 rad/s^2.
diagnosed_defects.repaired_metric: Simscape commanded force exactly matches Pinocchio joint base force to 15 decimal places (-2.375 N, 385.675 N, 661.323 N). Initial hip angular acceleration matches (-1.139 rad/s^2 vs -1.140 rad/s^2).

frames_1_to_30_0_080s.status: 1.7 micrometer agreement (matches Gate 2 early threshold of 12.0 mm)

full_horizon_307_frames_0_850s.note: Divergence accumulates on floating base hip coordinate under ode23t (RelTol 1e-3). Tightening to RelTol 1e-6 reduces max coord discrepancy to 96.38 mm, showing solver sensitivity under initial qualification. Subject to bounded solver-convergence audit.
